newsitem.title: GERMANY: New German MDAX future starts trade.
newsitem.headline: New German MDAX future starts trade.

text.p: The German bourse on Monday launched a new futures contract on its recently created MDAX index for medium-sized German shares.
Trade in MDAX futures runs from 0700 GMT to 1500 GMT. The December future started trade at 2,900 and was quoted at 2,894.0 at 1100 GMT. A total of 453 MDAX futures had been traded by then.
The contract can be found on Reuters by typing MDX: and pressing F3.
The 70-share MDAX index was launched this year as part of Germany's push to attract interest to the mid-cap market.
